content.headline: Dental care that explains itself before it begins.
content.lede: Checkups, cleanings, and repairs for adults and children. We show you what we see, tell you what it costs, and let you decide.
content.secondaryAction: See what a first visit includes
content.servicesIntro: Three kinds of visit cover most of what people need.

services.title: Checkups and cleanings
services.body: A full look, a careful clean, and photographs of anything worth watching, explained in plain words.

services.title: Repairs
services.body: Fillings, crowns, and chipped teeth. You see the price and the options before any work starts.

services.title: Urgent visits
services.body: Pain, swelling, or a broken tooth. Call before ten and we will see you the same day when a chair is free.

content.aboutBody: Two dentists and one hygienist. You see the same people each time, and they remember what you told them last time.
content.promise: No work starts until you have seen the price and said yes.
content.contactBody: Tell us how to reach you and what you need. We reply on the next working day.
